apps.name: US TTS
apps.desc:
US TTS is a fast, zero-delay multi-engine Text-to-Speech (TTS) router built for TalkBack, Jieshuo, and other Android screen reader users.Key Features:
• Multi-Language Routing (90+ Languages): Assign your preferred TTS engine, voice, speed, and pitch to each language with instant Dual Mode, Mix Mode, and Single Mode switching.
• Smart Text & Number Reading: Cleanly filters emojis and decorative symbols, reads OTPs and phone numbers digit-by-digit, supports Lakh/Crore amounts, and expands common abbreviations.
• Custom Dictionary & Regex Rules: Fix pronunciation for any word using simple replacements or advanced Regex rules.
• Call Announcer: Announces incoming Phone (SIM) and WhatsApp calls with caller name or number, repeating until answered or declined.
• Time Announcer: Speaks the time every 10, 30, or 60 minutes (in English or Urdu) with a built-in bell chime, optional date/battery alerts, and night quiet hours.
• Text to Audio Export: Convert any text into MP3 or WAV audio files and save them directly to your phone storage.
• Compatibility: Works smoothly on Android 5.0 to Android 16.
